notes: resolve_goal() implements CREATED (atomic mkstemp+os.link create, best-effort dir fsync, reread+validate) and REUSED (existing goal.md with v1 marker + compatible() True, no write). Existing document that does not match REUSED falls into a single PRESERVED branch with a placeholder reason ("not yet classified") -- deliberately not implemented further (T018, later node), structured so that task only refines reason into its three named cases without restructuring resolve_goal. main() dispatches generically on GoalResult.status: exit 2 for BLOCKED, exit 0 otherwise, emitting one sorted-key JSON line with status/path/sha256/version (version omitted when the read-back text carries no marker) and reason (present for BLOCKED and PRESERVED). Imports grill_core.goal_document as a plain package import (SSOT never redeclared: VERSION, MARKER, ESSENTIAL, compatible, managed_version all imported, none copied).

CLI --ensure /tmp (not a Git top-level) -> {"reason":"ROOT must be existing Git top-level","status":"BLOCKED"}, exit 2
